item.title: Kinectron + p5.js — gestures, sketch controls and GIF export
item.description: For a creative-coding class I needed Kinectron skeleton data inside p5.js, with simple play / stop controls and a way to export a short GIF for demos. The sketch draws every tracked joint as a dot, checks six gestures on each body frame, and answers them with particle effects: fireworks on a clap, rising bubbles when a hand is above the hips, falling stars when it is below. As a side experiment, a clap could also toggle a smart device through a tiny local Node server. Notes below follow the code I used.
